title: 첫 5초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Jazz-Pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays jazz-influenced seventh chords with light chorus and reverb. A fretless bass provides melodic counterpoint with slides and vibrato. Drums feature a crisp snare and tight hi-hats playing a swing-inflected groove. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational baritone, transitioning into a light falsetto during melodic leaps. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the syncopated guitar comping. Key of E Major, 82 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing jazz chords, fretless bass slides]

[Verse 1]
[smooth male vocals]
전화가 울렸잖아 [bass counterpoint]

10년 넘게 알던 사람인데
